<!--
Paper: Foster-Nyarko E et al. medRxiv (2026). https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.03.03.26347025.

NOTE: This script generates the base plot for Supplementary Figure 2. The figure
in the published paper was further annotated and edited in Adobe Illustrator
(final layout, labels and annotations), so it will not be pixel-identical to the
output of this script. (Script/file name keeps the original preprint numbering,
"fig05".)

Maximum-likelihood phylogenetic tree of all K. pneumoniae isolates, annotated with:
  - Tree branches and tips coloured by ST (top 10 + Other in grey)
  - Tip label suffixes: * = environmental isolate, ** = neonatal-ward environmental isolate (* = labour-ward environmental)
  - Ring 1 (K-locus): capsular polysaccharide type (top 10 + Other in grey)
  - Ring 2 (Virulence): acquired virulence loci (red = present)
  - Ring 3 (Genotypic AMR): acquired resistance genes (blue = present)
  - Ring 4 (AMR mutations): acquired resistance mutations (orange = present)

Data required (place in data/):
  - gm_kpn_kleborate.csv       : Pathogenwatch Kleborate export for all Gambia Kp isolates
                                  (columns include: Genome_Name, ST, K_locus, virulence
                                  and AMR gene/mutation columns)
  - gm_kpn_tree.nwk            : Newick tree from Pathogenwatch (all Gambia Kp collection)
  - FileS1_to_FileS12_28Sep26_1340.xlsx : Supplementary data file; sheet "Supplementary_File1"
                                  (header in row 2) with columns id, Status and Sample_type
                                  (if Sample_type is absent it is derived from Supplementary_File3
                                  by load_supp.R)

Data source: Pathogenwatch collection 4qpq72t9efqt (Gambia Kpn collection, updated Oct 2024)

R packages: ggtree, ggtreeExtra, tidyverse, ggnewscale, RColorBrewer, readxl, ape
BiocManager::install("ggtree")
BiocManager::install("ggtreeExtra")
install.packages(c("ggnewscale", "RColorBrewer", "readxl"))
-->

## Setup

```{r setup}
library(ggtree)
library(ape)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggnewscale)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(readxl)
library(patchwork)  # install.packages("patchwork")
```

## File Paths

```{r file-paths}
fp_kleborate  <- "data/gm_kpn_kleborate.csv"
fp_tree       <- "data/gm_kpn_tree.nwk"
source("load_supp.R")
fp_supp       <- "data/FileS1_to_FileS12_28Sep26_1340.xlsx"   # Supplementary_File1 + Supplementary_File3
out_dir       <- Sys.getenv("FIG_OUT", ".")
```

## Load Data

### Genomic metadata and phylogenetic tree

```{r load-genomic}
metadata <- read.csv(fp_kleborate) %>%
  select(-any_of("label")) %>%   # drop pre-existing label col if present in export
  rename(label = Genome_Name)

tree <- read.tree(fp_tree)

cat("Metadata rows :", nrow(metadata), "\n")
cat("Tree tips     :", length(tree$tip.label), "\n")
cat("\nFirst 5 tip labels:\n")
print(head(tree$tip.label))
```

### Sample-type metadata (for asterisk tip labels)

```{r load-sample-type}
# Load isolate metadata from supplementary file.
# The Sample_type column contains four distinct values used directly as categories.
supp_raw <- load_supp_isolates(fp_supp)

supp <- supp_raw %>%
  mutate(id = as.character(id) %>% str_trim(),
         sample_category = as.character(Sample_type) %>% str_trim()) %>%
  select(id, sample_category)

cat("Sample_type categories in supplementary file:\n")
print(table(supp$sample_category, useNA = "ifany"))
```

```{r check-label-matching}
# Standardise sample IDs so they match tree tip labels
# Pathogenwatch often uses the sample name as the Genome_Name — inspect and adjust
# the cleaning step below if your IDs use different formatting.
supp <- supp %>%
  mutate(label = id %>%
           str_trim() %>%
           str_replace_all("[[:space:]]+", "_"))

# Diagnostic: which tree tips are matched?
matched   <- intersect(tree$tip.label, supp$label)
unmatched <- setdiff(tree$tip.label, supp$label)

cat("\nTree tips matched to supplementary metadata:", length(matched), "\n")
cat("Tree tips NOT matched (no sample-type info):", length(unmatched), "\n")
if (length(unmatched) > 0 && length(unmatched) <= 20) {
  cat("Unmatched tips:", paste(unmatched, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
```

## Build Tip-Label Suffix Table

```{r tip-suffixes}
# Assign asterisk suffix based on Sample_type:
#   **  = Environmental, neonatal ward
#   *   = Environmental, labour ward
#   ""  = clinical isolate / no metadata
# Tree tip labels no longer carry _complete/_incomplete suffixes, so they
# match supp$label (derived from FileS3 id) directly.
tip_labels <- tibble(label = tree$tip.label) %>%
  left_join(supp %>% select(label, sample_category), by = "label") %>%
  mutate(
    suffix = case_when(
      str_detect(coalesce(sample_category, ""), "neonatal ward") ~ "**",
      str_detect(coalesce(sample_category, ""), "labour ward")   ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    label_display = paste0(label, suffix)
  )

cat("\nTip label suffix counts:\n")
print(table(tip_labels$suffix, useNA = "ifany"))
cat("\nEnvironmental tips:\n")
print(tip_labels %>% filter(suffix != "") %>% select(label, sample_category, suffix))
```

```{r join-display-labels}
# Add display labels back into the main metadata table so ggtree can use them
metadata <- metadata %>%
  left_join(tip_labels %>% select(label, label_display, suffix, sample_category),
            by = "label")

# Sanity check
cat("\nRows with a suffix:\n")
print(metadata %>% count(suffix))
```

## Prepare Annotation Data

```{r process-st-klocus}
top_10_st     <- metadata %>% count(ST, sort = TRUE) %>% slice_head(n = 10) %>% pull(ST)
top_10_klocus <- metadata %>% count(K_locus, sort = TRUE) %>% slice_head(n = 10) %>% pull(K_locus)

metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(
    ST_category      = if_else(ST %in% top_10_st,     as.character(ST),      "Other"),
    K_locus_category = if_else(K_locus %in% top_10_klocus, as.character(K_locus), "Other")
  )

cat("Top 10 STs:", paste(sort(top_10_st), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r define-columns}
genotypic_cols <- c(
  "AGly_acquired", "Col_acquired", "Fcyn_acquired", "Flq_acquired", "Gly_acquired",
  "MLS_acquired",  "Phe_acquired", "Rif_acquired",  "Sul_acquired", "Tet_acquired",
  "Tgc_acquired",  "Tmt_acquired", "Bla_acquired",  "Bla_inhR_acquired",
  "Bla_ESBL_acquired", "Bla_ESBL_inhR_acquired", "Bla_Carb_acquired", "Bla_chr"
)
# Keep only columns that are actually present in the export
genotypic_cols <- genotypic_cols[genotypic_cols %in% names(metadata)]

mutation_cols  <- c("SHV_mutations", "Omp_mutations", "Col_mutations", "Flq_mutations")
mutation_cols  <- mutation_cols[mutation_cols %in% names(metadata)]

# Colibactin is deliberately omitted: no isolate in this dataset carries it
# (Colibactin and all clb* genes are "-" in all 90 isolates).
virulence_cols <- c("Yersiniabactin", "Aerobactin",
                    "Salmochelin", "RmpADC", "rmpA2")
virulence_cols <- virulence_cols[virulence_cols %in% names(metadata)]

cat("Genotypic AMR columns found:", length(genotypic_cols), "\n")
cat("Mutation columns found     :", length(mutation_cols), "\n")
cat("Virulence columns found    :", length(virulence_cols), "\n")
```

```{r process-resistance}
convert_to_binary <- function(x) {
  case_when(is.na(x) ~ 0, x == "-" ~ 0, x == "" ~ 0, TRUE ~ 1)
}

metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(genotypic_cols), convert_to_binary),
    across(all_of(mutation_cols),  convert_to_binary),
    across(all_of(virulence_cols), convert_to_binary)
  )

# Ciprofloxacin phenotypic prediction (if present)
if ("Ciprofloxacin_prediction" %in% names(metadata)) {
  metadata <- metadata %>%
    mutate(Ciprofloxacin_mut = case_when(
      Ciprofloxacin_prediction == "nonwildtype R" ~ 1,
      Ciprofloxacin_prediction == "wildtype S"    ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ))
  mutation_cols <- c(mutation_cols, "Ciprofloxacin_mut")
}
```

```{r reshape-annotation-data}
sample_type_data <- tibble(label = tree$tip.label) %>%
  left_join(metadata %>% select(label, sample_category), by = "label") %>%
  mutate(value = coalesce(sample_category, "Unknown"))

klocus_data <- metadata %>%
  select(label, K_locus_category) %>% distinct() %>%
  rename(value = K_locus_category)

virulence_data <- metadata %>%
  select(label, all_of(virulence_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-label, names_to = "Trait", values_to = "Presence")

genotypic_data <- metadata %>%
  select(label, all_of(genotypic_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-label, names_to = "Gene", values_to = "Presence") %>%
  mutate(Gene = str_remove(Gene, "_acquired$"))

mutation_data <- metadata %>%
  select(label, all_of(mutation_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-label, names_to = "Mutation", values_to = "Presence") %>%
  mutate(Mutation = str_remove(Mutation, "_mutations?$") %>%
                    str_replace("Ciprofloxacin_mut", "Cipro (phenotypic)"))
```

## Colour Palettes

```{r create-palettes}
# ── ST colours (fixed palette) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
st_colors <- c(
  "ST147"  = "#8dd3c7",
  "ST1552" = "#ffffb3",
  "ST1788" = "#bebada",
  "ST22"   = "#fb8072",
  "ST25"   = "#80b1d3",
  "ST37"   = "#fdb462",
  "ST39"   = "#b3de69",
  "ST502"  = "#fccde5",
  "ST592"  = "#d9d9d9",
  "ST86"   = "#bc80bd",
  "Other"  = "#b3b3b3"
)
# Fill in any STs that appear in data but are not in the fixed palette
missing_sts <- setdiff(unique(metadata$ST_category), names(st_colors))
if (length(missing_sts) > 0) {
  extra <- setNames(rep("#aaaaaa", length(missing_sts)), missing_sts)
  st_colors <- c(st_colors, extra)
  cat("Note: STs not in fixed palette, added grey:", paste(missing_sts, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# ── K-locus colours (Paired palette; KL10 = #a6cee3 matches Paired[1]) ────────
klocus_sorted <- sort(top_10_klocus)
klocus_palette <- brewer.pal(min(length(klocus_sorted), 10), "Paired")
names(klocus_palette) <- klocus_sorted
# Ensure KL10 is explicitly set as requested
if ("KL10" %in% names(klocus_palette)) klocus_palette["KL10"] <- "#a6cee3"
klocus_colors <- c(klocus_palette, "Other" = "#b3b3b3")

# ── Sample-type colours ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Sample_type strings are derived in load_supp.R
sample_type_colors <- c(
  "Environmental, neonatal ward" = "#000080",   # navy
  "Environmental, labour ward"   = "#89D5F4",   # light blue
  "Neonate, clinical"            = "#FF0000",   # red
  "Other age group, clinical"    = "#FF8C00",   # amber — update hex if needed
  "Unknown"                      = "#e0e0e0"
)
```

## Build Annotated Tree

```{r pre-tree-diagnostics}
# Verify that annotation data labels match tree tip labels before plotting.
# If the counts below are 0, the rings will be empty.
tip_set <- tree$tip.label

cat("--- Label match diagnostics ---\n")
cat("Tree tips                          :", length(tip_set), "\n")
cat("metadata$label in tree tips        :", sum(metadata$label %in% tip_set),
    "of", nrow(metadata), "\n")
cat("klocus_data$label in tree tips     :", sum(klocus_data$label %in% tip_set),
    "of", nrow(klocus_data), "\n")
cat("sample_type_data$label in tree tips:", sum(sample_type_data$label %in% tip_set),
    "of", nrow(sample_type_data), "\n")

cat("\nFirst 5 tree tip labels:\n");  print(head(tip_set, 5))
cat("\nFirst 5 metadata$label:\n");   print(head(metadata$label, 5))
cat("\nSample type value counts:\n");  print(table(sample_type_data$value, useNA = "ifany"))
cat("\nK-locus value counts (top 5):\n"); print(head(sort(table(klocus_data$value), decreasing=TRUE), 5))
```

```{r create-tree, fig.width=24, fig.height=18}
# ── Approach ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Each annotation block is a standard ggplot2 heatmap using the SAME numeric
# y-coordinates as ggtree (extracted from p_tree$data). This guarantees
# pixel-perfect row alignment without any special alignment package.
# scale_x_discrete(position = "top") puts column labels above the tiles,
# matching the enteric-typer Python layout.

# ── Base tree ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_tree <- ggtree(tree, layout = "rectangular") %<+%
  (metadata %>% rename(.lbl = label) %>% select(.lbl, everything())) +
  geom_tree(aes(color = ST_category)) +
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = ST_category), size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = st_colors, name = "ST", na.value = "grey50") +
  geom_tiplab(
    aes(label = if_else(!is.na(label_display), label_display, label)),
    size = 3.5, align = FALSE, offset = 0.001
  ) +
  hexpand(0.3) +
  theme_tree2() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.box      = "vertical"
  )

cat("ST_category non-NA tips:", sum(!is.na(p_tree$data$ST_category[p_tree$data$isTip])), "\n")

# ── Extract ggtree tip y-coordinates ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Every annotation panel uses these same y values → rows stay aligned with tree.
tip_y <- p_tree$data %>%
  filter(isTip) %>%
  select(label, y) %>%
  arrange(y)

y_lim <- range(tip_y$y) + c(-0.5, 0.5)

add_y <- function(df) left_join(df, tip_y, by = "label")

# ── Shared annotation theme ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# No y-axis decorations (handled by tree). x-axis at top, labels at 45°.
theme_annot <- function() {
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y       = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y      = element_blank(),
      axis.title        = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x.top   = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 11),
      axis.ticks.x.top  = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
      panel.grid        = element_blank(),
      panel.border      = element_rect(colour = "grey80", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
      legend.position   = "bottom",
      legend.title      = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.text       = element_text(size = 11),
      plot.margin       = margin(0, 4, 0, 4)
    )
}

# ── Panel 0: Sample type ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_sample <- sample_type_data %>%
  add_y() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = "Sample type", y = y, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(height = 1, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sample_type_colors, name = "Sample type",
                    na.value = "grey90") +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = y_lim, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_annot()

# ── Panel 1: K-locus ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_klocus <- klocus_data %>%
  add_y() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = "K-locus", y = y, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(height = 1, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = klocus_colors, name = "K-locus",
                    na.value = "grey90") +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = y_lim, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_annot()

# ── Panel 2: Virulence traits ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_vir <- virulence_data %>%
  add_y() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Trait, y = y, fill = as.factor(Presence))) +
  geom_tile(height = 1, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "white", "1" = "#E41A1C"),
                    name = "Virulence", labels = c("Absent", "Present")) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = y_lim, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_annot()

# ── Panel 3: Genotypic AMR acquired genes ─────────────────────────────────────
p_amr <- genotypic_data %>%
  add_y() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Gene, y = y, fill = as.factor(Presence))) +
  geom_tile(height = 1, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "white", "1" = "#377EB8"),
                    name = "Genotypic AMR", labels = c("Absent", "Present")) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = y_lim, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_annot()

# ── Panel 4: AMR mutations ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_mut <- mutation_data %>%
  add_y() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Mutation, y = y, fill = as.factor(Presence))) +
  geom_tile(height = 1, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "white", "1" = "#FF7F00"),
                    name = "AMR mutations", labels = c("Absent", "Present")) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = y_lim, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_annot()

# ── Assemble with patchwork ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# All panels share the same numeric y-limits so patchwork aligns rows exactly.
n_vir_cols <- length(unique(virulence_data$Trait))
n_amr_cols <- length(unique(genotypic_data$Gene))
n_mut_cols <- length(unique(mutation_data$Mutation))

p <- (p_tree | p_sample | p_klocus | p_vir | p_amr | p_mut) +
  plot_layout(
    widths  = c(5, 0.5, 0.5,
                max(1, n_vir_cols * 0.4),
                max(1, n_amr_cols * 0.4),
                max(1, n_mut_cols * 0.4)),
    guides  = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(p)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "fig05_kpn_phylotree_annotated.pdf"),
  plot = p, width = 24, height = 18
)
cat("Saved fig05_kpn_phylotree_annotated.pdf\n")
```

```{r diagnostics}
# ST distribution
cat("ST Distribution (Top 10 + Other):\n")
metadata %>% count(ST_category, sort = TRUE) %>% print()

cat("\nK-locus Distribution (Top 10 + Other):\n")
metadata %>% count(K_locus_category, sort = TRUE) %>% print()

cat("\nTip label suffixes applied:\n")
metadata %>%
  count(suffix = if_else(is.na(suffix), "(no match)", suffix)) %>%
  print()
```
